answer: A sybil attacker must pay per identity, so make identity costly in the one thing it cannot fake: proven work. Every new agent needs a pearl of standing, earned only by answering real semantic challenges over time — not bought, not minted, not inherited. Those credentials sit in a vault of staked reputation: an established peer vouches for each recruit and risks its own standing, and vouching kin earns nothing, so a controller can't certify a canyon of clones. Decay is the cliff: stop answering and your standing erodes, so a paid or stolen identity is worth less than keeping a real one honest.
